topic: Superposition and Quantum States: The Architecture of Quantum Reality

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Classical vs. Quantum Divide
lecture_lines: Classical bits are either zero or one.
Quantum states exist in a continuum.
Think of a dimmer light switch.
animations: Fade in classical bit label #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/switch.svg].
Show quantum state vector |ψ⟩ in color #FFFF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg].
Highlight difference between deterministic and probabilistic.

sections.title: Defining Superposition: The Mathematical Foundation
lecture_lines: It is a linear combination, not a mixture.
Like a coin spinning before landing.
animations: Highlight coefficient α for state |0⟩ in #00FF00.
Highlight coefficient β for state |1⟩ in #FF00FF.

sections.title: Visualization: The Bloch Sphere
lecture_lines: The Bloch Sphere visualizes quantum states.
The vector points to any surface coordinate.
Rotation around the sphere represents phase.
animations: Add state vector arrow |ψ⟩ pointing to center of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].
Animate state vector moving to poles |0⟩, |1⟩ on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].
Highlight surface area of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] representing potential states.

sections.title: The Collapse: Measurement and Reality
lecture_lines: Measurement forces a collapse to basis states.
The Born rule calculates the probability.
Opening the box determines the outcome.
animations: Display state vector |ψ⟩ stored within a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/box.svg] before measurement.
Animate measurement operation on state vector.
Show vector collapse to |0⟩ or |1⟩ in #FF0000.
